original_target.title: Does cyclic monotonicity imply optimality for finite Borel multi-marginal costs?

scope_comparison: The survey still asks the finite Borel-cost extension under the integrable marginal envelope. The published sufficiency theorem assumes continuous cost and compact supports; the known counterexample allows infinite costs. The GitHub roadmap explicitly forbids the unproved extended-Borel claim and is not a completed proof. Rochet payment characterizations and two-marginal theorems differ.
